propositions: A new LLM criterion ac-process-gate must detect acceptance criteria that are generic mechanical process gates (children-closed, tests/CI/plan-review/completion-verifier pass, merged/landed, commit-trailer/DCO) identically satisfied on any unrelated ticket.

The ac-process-gate criterion must accept ACs that name or depend on the ticket's specific deliverable (artifact, behavior, test, doc, config, criterion) even when the subject is testing or plan-review itself.

The ac-process-gate criterion registers as advisory 1-TURN in CANONICAL_LLM (not CODEBASE_GROUNDED), with routing entry in criteria_routing.json, facet ac-text-quality, scope container+leaf, and a two-key checklist (not-applicable gate, per-AC judgment).
The rubric prompt, guide section, eval spec (≥2 fire, ≥2 no-fire, ≤8 cases), and deterministic unit tests must all exist and validate together without orphans or mismatches.
Live bounded-sanity eval must show recall=1.0 and false_accept=0.0 on process-gate and deliverable ACs, with result committed to docs/experiments/plan-review-gate/runs/ac_process_gate_sanity.json.

Collateral fix: chunk_by_facet packer changed to balanced packing (ceil(n/size) near-equal chunks, [2,size] for n≥2) to prevent singleton strands; stale hard-coded criteria COUNT removed from docs and registry; golden pins updated.
